question: The pH value of the neutral solution is __________
solution:
The correct answer is __**7**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• A neutral solution has a pH value of **7**.
 
• The pH scale ranges from **0 to 14**, with 7 being neutral.
 
• Pure water, which is a neutral solution, has a pH value of **7** at 25°C.
 
• A pH value less than 7 indicates an acidic solution, while a pH value greater than 7 indicates a basic solution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **pH Scale**

 
 
• The pH scale measures the acidity or basicity of a solution.
 
• It is a logarithmic scale, meaning each whole number change represents a tenfold change in acidity/basicity.
 
• A pH value of 7 is considered neutral, values below 7 are acidic, and values above 7 are basic or alkaline.
 
 
 
• **Acids and Bases**
 
 
• Acids have a pH less than 7 and release hydrogen ions (H⁺) in solution.
 
• Bases have a pH greater than 7 and release hydroxide ions (OH⁻) in solution.
 
• Common examples include hydrochloric acid (HCl) for acids and sodium hydroxide (NaOH) for bases.
 
 
 
• **Neutralization**
 
 
• Neutralization is a chemical reaction between an acid and a base, producing water and a salt.
 
• This reaction can help bring the pH of a solution closer to 7.
 
• The general form of the reaction is: Acid + Base → Salt + Water.
 
 
 
• **Importance of pH**
 
 
• pH is crucial in various fields including chemistry, biology, medicine, agriculture, and environmental science.
 
• Many biological processes are pH-dependent, such as enzyme activity and cellular metabolism.
 
• Soil pH affects plant growth and nutrient availability.
